title: Utility Services Terms: Household Tolerance Allowance in Leak Adjustment Credits
content:
# Household Tolerance Allowance — Utility Services Program Leak Adjustments

**Term.** In a Utility Services Program leak adjustment, the capped leak excess is reduced by a household tolerance allowance: the usual water usage of a leak adjustment times a household tolerance share set by the approved occupants on the Apartment Home Lease.

| Approved occupants on the lease | Household tolerance share |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.20 |
| exactly 3 | 0.10 |
| 1 or 2 | 0 |

The allowance is rounded to 3 decimals, and the credited leak excess is the capped leak excess less the allowance, never below zero, rounded to 3 decimals.

**Record read.** The approved occupants count of the lease — not a resident's statement of who lives in the apartment home.

## Cases (hypothetical usual usage of 3.000 thousand gallons, capped leak excess 9.300)

- Five approved occupants: allowance 0.600; credited leak excess 8.700.
- Three approved occupants: allowance 0.300; credited leak excess 9.000.
- Two approved occupants: allowance 0; credited leak excess 9.300.
- Four approved occupants and a capped leak excess of only 0.500: allowance 0.600; credited leak excess 0 (never below zero).
